name: Rocket.Chat
label: Rocket.Chat — Rocket.Chat REST API
description: Rocket.Chat via the official Rocket.Chat REST API. Host is customer-supplied (config host). Docs: https://developer.rocket.chat/apidocs and https://developer.rocket.chat/apidocs/authentication-api. Every authenticated call sends X-Auth-Token (auth_token) plus X-User-Id ({user_id} extraHeader). listen = BPMN message events. Handler: OfficialApiNode (api_spec.json). OUTPUT is {status,http_status,data} or {error}. Inbound provider events are BPMN message events (operation listen), not a Webhook node.
author: 5c8b0d45-1d10-4f2e-844c-2318af96b2fa

ports.name: input
ports.description: One Rocket.Chat operation. Set operation plus the fields that operation needs. Do not put secrets on this port. Example: {"operation":"post-message"}.

schema.label: operation
schema.description: Which official call to run. EXACT values: post-message | send-dm | list-channels | listen. listen / send-and-wait are kind:ingress — the handler does not open a socket; use a BPMN message start/catch/boundary event. Example: first verb.

schema.label: channel
schema.description: Channel name or #channel. Purpose: operation input. Omit when unused.

schema.label: roomId
schema.description: DM / room id for send-dm. Purpose: operation input. Omit when unused.

schema.label: text
schema.description: Message text. Purpose: operation input. Omit when unused.

ports.name: output
ports.description: Result object. Success: {status:'ok', http_status, data}. Ingress operations return a message telling the operator to use a BPMN message event. Secrets never appear. Errors raise a BPMN error for the error boundary event (INVALID_INPUT, AUTH_FAILED, RATE_LIMITED, HTTP_<status>, REQUEST_FAILED); secrets are redacted.

schema.label: status
schema.description: Present on HTTP success. EXACT: ok.

schema.label: data
schema.description: Parsed JSON body from the provider, or raw text if not JSON. Never contains secrets.

configurationParameters.label: Operation
configurationParameters.description: Default operation when INPUT omits operation. EXACT: post-message, send-dm, list-channels, listen. listen/send-and-wait instruct the operator to use BPMN message events.

configurationParameters.label: Auth token
configurationParameters.description: Rocket.Chat personal auth token (X-Auth-Token). StudioQuack secret. Pair with user_id. Never log. Never put on INPUT.

configurationParameters.label: user_id
configurationParameters.description: Rocket.Chat user id sent as header X-User-Id on every authenticated call (with X-Auth-Token). Required. Never put the auth token on INPUT.

configurationParameters.label: Timeout (seconds)
configurationParameters.description: Connect+read timeout for each official HTTPS call. Positive integer. Default 25. 0/blank → 25.
